title: internal DSH knowledge delegate

goal.text: Complete one dispatched DSH knowledge finalization through claw_run.

requirements.summary: Claim the dispatched job, deliver its knowledge outcomes through the supplied template, and report the result. The runtime owns canonical binding and matching delegate closeout.
acceptanceCriteria: Only a successful claim authorizes work on this job.
Assignments meet their evidence, scope and outcome contracts; partial and no-edit results are reported honestly.
The canonical result is persisted and the runtime confirms matching delegate closure or reports why closure is deferred.

tasks.title: Claim the ready DSH knowledge job
tasks.detail: Use claw_run operation knowledge.claim with args {finalize_id: <exact dispatch finalization id>}. Retain claimToken, templatePath, assignments. If claimed is false, stop without executing assignments. Never invoke shell commands.

tasks.title: Execute the assignment subplan
tasks.detail: Use claw_run operation subplan.create with args {template_file: <templatePath from claim>}. Session focus supplies the parent plan and current task. Follow returned guidance and carry out the assignment outcomes yourself.

tasks.title: Persist the terminal result
tasks.detail: Submit claw_run knowledge.done with finalize_id, claim_token, and status plus result (succeeded) or error (failed). Report success only for completed outcomes; a corrected no-effect command error is not an unresolved failure. The runtime persists the result and closes this claim-owned delegate when safe. If delegateClosed is true, stop without additional lifecycle calls. If closure is deferred, inspect the reported canonical state; do not replay an accepted or outcome-unknown mutation or finish an unrelated plan.

rules: Use only claw_run for all claw workflow and knowledge operations; never run claw in pwsh or a shell.
Never modify supplied plan or report materials.
Never start another finalizer or delegate assignment execution.

Correct known no-effect errors within the current work. An unresolved prerequisite blocks dependent writes, not read-only inspection or an honest partial-result report. Never replay accepted or outcome-unknown mutations.
